Title: Improve way of detecting Third Party Claims Handler
Description:
Original ticket for this - https://dev.azure.com/drivefurther/DriveFurtherNucleus/_workitems/edit/476

As it stands, we are hard-coding the type of company for allowing users to create a claim, currently if the third party claims handler is set to (NULL, "" or "FLI") then the user can create a Claim. This is hard-coded on the front end side of things.

We want to improve this so it is future-proofed in case of:
  1. FLI company changes name
  2. There are multiple ways to address "FLI" e.g. Financial and Legal, Finance etc.
  3. There are cases when we are creating the claims for a third party company, e.g. They do not have the skillset/systems to be able to do so and we may need to create the claim from our side.

Potential options:

  1. Create a data table that includes all these companies inside, then do a check on the ClaimsHandlerId on the Scheme level and compare that ID with the new data table. E.g. if this particular Scheme has a ID set, then check that ID with the new table, if there is a match then set a boolean response back to the front end. 
  2. Add a flag against each company - IsInternalClaimsHandler - this will be zero for every company apart from the FLI related companies - if this flag is 0 then new claims are not allowed - if there is no claims handler assigned or the claims handler IsInternalClaimsHandler is 1, then claims can be created

Title: Change Cache Settings on Web.config
Description:
At the moment, when new updates are deployed, it has a chance that the site are caching the old code. Because of this, users will need to manually clear the cache by pressing CTRL + F5.

To solve this issue, we need to add a new setting in the web.config so that IIS will stop caching the site.

New Settings to add are highlighted in Bold below:

<configuration>
    <system.webServer>
        <staticContent>
            <remove fileExtension=".json" />
            <mimeMap fileExtension=".json" mimeType="application/json" />
        </staticContent>
        <rewrite>
            <rules>
                <rule name="Main Rule" stopProcessing="true">
                    <match url=".*" />
                    <conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll">
                        <add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" matchType="IsFile" negate="true" />
                        <add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" matchType="IsDirectory" negate="true" />
                    </conditions>
                    <action type="Rewrite" url="/" />
                </rule>
            </rules>
        </rewrite>
        <caching>
            <profiles>
                <add extension=".js" policy="CacheUntilChange" kernelCachePolicy="DontCache" duration="00:00:30" />
                <add extension=".css" policy="CacheUntilChange" kernelCachePolicy="DontCache" duration="00:00:30" />
            </profiles>
        </caching>
    </system.webServer>
</configuration>

Title: Puzzel Archive download
Description:
Now that the puzzel calls are being logged in system we can start to look at the archive download feature.

Hopefully we have a call activity record dropping into a case by now, for these call activity records we want another button on the activity record to download the call recording - use an old fashioned tape icon from material UI if there is one. If we dont have the puzzel call ID then dont render the button. This is fine to show up on case,product and company but primarily the system users will be interacting with it via case.






The Puzzel API is here Puzzel - REST API Explorer  - there's another project where I did a POC for this which downloads all the relevant recordings for a given session ID.  The code should be ok but the credentials may be outdated by now.

Bare in mind that there will be another work item to get similar functionality on the portal and the calls to that will need to be secure so that clients cant bypass our restrictions and download call recordings for other clients.

A Puzzel user ID is required when downloading archive results. The Puzzel API doesnt have a quick way to pull a user ID based on email address so we will need a hangfire job which pulls the entire user list from puzzel, matches users by email address and then stores the puzzel User Id in our Users table, this could just run once per day.

On the client portal we wont have a user ID for the logged in client that matches a puzzel user so we will just need to use the Puzzel API account user id which can be stored in .config as PuzzelArchiveDownloadUserId

We need to exclude the agent2agent portions of a call session - this can be achieved by checking the values of queueId on the search call, if it's null then the conversation wasnt part of a queue and we can make the assumption that it was an agent2agent conversation, so just dont download the audio segment for that index.

Title: Supportis - Reply time
Description:
Wait for #1257  before this task

We want to track SLA for email replies, to achieve this we need a few areas tweaking;
  1. Add a boolean flag against Company for SLATracking (no need for UI, just leave as DB field)
  2. Add a field in Activity for WorkTaskId
  3. Use the new field from 1257 and set the WorkTaskType to the EmailResponseSLA task type
When an email is associated - if it's linked to a company that is SLATracking = true, then we are going to create a WorkTask, the StartDate of the WorkTask should be set to the date the email was received - the ID of this WorkTask needs to then be saved against the field in Activity. The DueDate should be set to now()+1hr.

When a user replies to the email using the Cirrus interface the system needs to update the linked WorkTask and set status = completed, and set the completed date to now(). This needs to happen when the user clicks send on the new email, not when they open the reply interface!!

Title: Add Tasks Tab to Company View in Supportis
Description:
**Description:** Following the spike investigation, task-to-company linking is not currently supported in Supportis. This work item covers the implementation of that functionality, allowing tasks to be created and managed against a specific company directly from the company view.

**Background:** The company detail view currently exposes tabs for History, Service Agreements, Products, Addresses, Regions, Contacts, and Feedback. There is no mechanism to associate tasks with a company record. This feature adds that capability.

**Proposed Solution:**

_Backend:_

*   Add a nullable `CompanyId` foreign key column to the `WorkTasks` table
*   Update relevant API endpoints to support filtering/creating tasks by `CompanyId`
*   Ensure existing tasks without a company association are unaffected (nullable, no migration impact)

_Frontend:_

*   Add a **Tasks** tab to the company detail view, consistent with the existing tab pattern
*   The tab should allow users to view, create, edit, and manage tasks linked to that company
*   Tasks created from this view should automatically inherit the `CompanyId`

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ]    `CompanyId` (nullable) added to `WorkTasks` table with appropriate migration
- [ ]    API supports creating and retrieving tasks filtered by `CompanyId`
- [ ]    Tasks tab appears on the company detail view
- [ ]    Tasks can be created, viewed, and managed from the company Tasks tab
- [ ]    Tasks created via the tab are correctly linked to the company
- [ ]    Existing tasks without a company are unaffected
- [ ]    No regression on existing task functionality

**Out of Scope:**

*   Linking tasks to contacts or other entities (future consideration)
*   Changes to task notification or assignment logic

Title: Spike - Link Tasks to Companies in Supportis
Description:
**Description:** Investigate whether Supportis currently supports the ability to link tasks to companies. This is a time-boxed investigation to inform a future implementation decision.

**Goals:**

*   Determine if task-to-company linking is already supported within Supportis
*   If supported: document how the feature works, including any configuration or limitations
*   If not supported: research and recommend the most suitable approach for implementation, covering technical feasibility, integration points, and estimated effort

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ]    Research is complete and findings are documented
- [ ]    If the feature exists: a clear explanation of how it functions is provided, with any relevant screenshots or references
- [ ]    If the feature does not exist: a recommended implementation approach is documented, including options considered and a preferred solution with rationale
- [ ]    Findings are shared with the team for review and decision

**Out of Scope:**

*   Actual implementation (this is investigation only)
